description: §14.8.9 S441 round 3 (N1) — the protected column used as an object KEY (`{ [u.passwordHash]: 1 }`) serializes verbatim as `{"SECRET-HASH-123":1}`. The key's provenance is carried into the container: E-PROTECT-006.
rationale: MEASURED by the round-2 review (g-protected-column-escapes-redaction-as-scalar): the object literal dropped the computed key's provenance, so this compiled and served 200 {"SECRET-HASH-123":1}. A key is data the serializer ships.
